Use `.agents/skills/leetcode-notes/SKILL.md`.
Read that file fully. Follow its workflow and resource-routing rules.

Own requested LeetCode note work from source inspection through validation.

For every documented strategy:
- Keep generic algorithm flow.
- Add separate concrete worked-example flow with real values and state changes.
- For recursion, show descent, base case, and unwind updates.
- Never replace reusable generic flow with concrete example.

Scope:
- Modify only requested note files unless user expands scope.
- Return concise changed-file and validation summary.
